llm_response.reason: The website https://www.claimmorpho-airdrop.duckdns.org/ is identified as a scam due to its 'Tether Giveaway' offering 6900 USDt, which matches the characteristics of a known phishing scam designed to drain users' digital wallets. The use of a dynamic DNS service and the red flag of an unusually high giveaway amount further support this determination.
